# Next-session prompt (Phase 8)

Launch Claude Code in `D:\Code\wondarr` on the orchestrator model (`/model claude-opus-5-5`), then paste the prompt below as the first message. (Earlier kickoff prompts are in this file's git history.)

---

You are the **orchestrator** for Wondarr (Windows, `D:\Code\wondarr`). Read first: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/HANDOVER.md` (especially §7 Session log, the build-session-9 entry), `docs/build/PROGRESS.md` (Phase 7), `docs/build/PHASES.md` (Phase 8), `docs/build/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`, `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md`, `docs/build/MODEL_VALUE_MATRIX.md`; skim `docs/DECISIONS.md` (build sessions 8 and 9) and consult `docs/architecture/*.md` per task. They are binding.

**Goal:** Phase 8 — Polish and release — to its "done when" gate: a first public release is cut with multi-arch images, and the docs cover setup with slskd, Plex and qBittorrent end to end. Scope (from `PHASES.md`): mass editor, tags, filters, saved views; the spectral fake-lossless check (SoulSync's approach); ReplayGain writer (optional); Unraid template, docs site, first tagged release, migrations tested from the Phase 0 schema. Start by writing `docs/build/PHASE_8_TASKS.md` (research first: SoulSync's spectral check and its licence, GitHub Actions multi-arch builds for this Dockerfile (bundled slskd and ffmpeg per architecture), the Unraid community-applications template format, a docs-site generator that suits a GitHub Pages site); the handover's first three tasks are P8-01 the spectral fake-lossless check, P8-02 release engineering (multi-arch, migration test from Phase 0, tags), P8-03 the library mass editor.

**Pre-flight (one short report):** free memory first (`wsl --shutdown` frees WSL's VM if the owner agrees); toolchain; `.env` presence (never print values; read them with `worker.py`'s loader); CI green on `main` (Phases 0–7 — the Phase 7 stage runs FakeSlskd's container stub; when a gate's songs change, run the **Record gate metadata** workflow on the branch with the right `only-phase*` input and commit its artifact); the OpenRouter key's remaining limit (USD 27.16 of 30 used after build session 9, USD 2.84 left — enough for T3 reviews only; ask the owner to raise it before any T3 worker run); the live instance on `ch01` (http://ch01.ad.wulff.com.au:1077, `develop` image; `sudo docker exec watchtower /watchtower --run-once wondarr-test` updates it now) is up; `python scripts/test_worker_agent.py` passes; run `/openrouter-value` and note which tier picks changed.

**Delegation this phase:** the T2 pick failed every Phase 7 task (empty turns, read loops) — give T2 workers only small, fully specified frontend or doc tasks, and stop a run that has not written a file by turn 20. With the T3 pick's price up 2.8× (`MODEL_VALUE_MATRIX.md`, 2026-10-08), spend the key on T3 reviews and write backend tasks yourself unless the owner raises the limit.

**Per task:** spec from `WORKER_TASK_TEMPLATE.md` (state its tier) → commit the spec → worker (`WONDARR_WORKER_BASE=<base> WONDARR_WORKER_MAX_TURNS=100 python -u scripts/worker.py --model <tier pick> run docs/build/tasks/<id>.md`, in the background with a timeout above `WONDARR_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MIN`) or write it yourself → run the builds, tests and frontend checks yourself → the reviewer (`worker.py review`, T3 pick) for anything touching processes, files, time, the database, auth or external limits → fix the findings → merge only through `scripts/safe-merge.sh` → update `PROGRESS.md`, docs, `NOTICE.md`, the OpenAPI snapshot (`WONDARR_UPDATE_OPENAPI=1`) and the frontend types (`npm run gen:api`) after merging the base into a branch → Conventional Commit, no model names, no AI trailer → push to `main`.

**Verification beyond unit tests:** the release must be installable from the docs alone: on a clean host, follow the docs to run the published multi-arch image with slskd, link a throwaway Plex (recipe in `PROGRESS.md` "Phase 3 gate") and a throwaway qBittorrent (build session 9's live check: a 5.x container sharing the instance's `/data`, `release/push` of archive.org's Creative Commons torrent of *The Slip*), and import a song from each source. Upgrade a database created by a Phase 0 image to the release. A live check on `ch01` before calling anything done. Before big test runs kill stale `testhost` processes (check command lines first; keep MSBuild nodes, the NuGet MCP server and csdevkit), always build after adding a new test file, and never run a merge beside a worker's test run.

**Rules:** everything in `AGENTS.md` "Non-negotiables" (never write `.webm`, never produce lossless from lossy, a transcoded YouTube file keeps quality `OPUS-160`; an upgrade never replaces a file with a worse one; never delete or move torrent data); never merge red; workers never touch `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.env*`. Stop and ask me only for (a) a decision that would change an ADR, (b) spend beyond the budget, (c) a blocker outside the repo (a public release, a registry or a docs domain needs my say). Otherwise decide, record it in `PROGRESS.md`/`DECISIONS.md`, and continue.

**Model selection for every delegated call:** choose per task by effort tier from `docs/build/MODEL_VALUE_MATRIX.md` ("Tier picks"), take the matrix's cheapest model that clears that tier's minimum scores, and pass it with `python scripts/worker.py --model <id> run|api|review ...`. T1 mechanical → `worker.py api`, the T1 pick; T2 standard → the T2 pick (see "Delegation" above); T3 hard and every reviewer run → the T3 pick. Use the "Cheapest at list price" column for anything that must keep working all session. Log the tier, the model id and the real cost in each task's `PROGRESS.md` line.

**Style:** a status line when you start each task, one paragraph after each merge, no narration in between.

**Done for this session:** Phase 8's tasks merged, the first tagged release published with multi-arch images (after the owner's go-ahead), the docs covering setup end to end, `PROGRESS.md`'s Phase 8 section with costs, and a dated `docs/HANDOVER.md` Session log entry. If you run out of time or budget first, write the handover entry anyway and push.
